عُوَادَةٌ : see عَوْدٌ, first and second sentences. ―
-b2- Also, (S, O, K,) and if you elide the ة you say ↓ عَوَادٌ , like لَمَاظٌ and قَضَامٌ, (Az, TA,) [in the O عَوَادَةٌ and عُوَادَةٌ with damm, (but the former is probably a mistranscription,)] Food brought again after its having been once eaten of: (S, O:) or food brought again for a particular man after a party has finished eating. (A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
